facts: The windowDeactivated signal contract requires hideOnWindowDeactivate=true and focus moving to neither a parent nor a child dialog.
Dialog::focusOutEvent checks hideOnWindowDeactivate, then checks active transient ancestors, active descendants or Qt.Popup focus windows before hiding and emitting windowDeactivated.
ItemListView temporarily sets kicker.hideOnWindowDeactivate=false before creating a submenu, then calls windowSystem.forceActive().
ItemListDialog binds its hideOnWindowDeactivate to the Kicker value, and delayedDestroy sets aboutToBeDestroyed before hiding; its QML close handler ignores deactivation after that guard.

interpretation: R595 correctly identified the X11-only Kicker forceActive call and a possible QML close path, but windowDeactivated is conditional. These sources do not prove that the user's hover sequence reaches that signal. R596 remains an unvalidated activation candidate; it is not yet confirmed as the fix.
